speaker: hero
text: Bit, I spend so much on *takeout*. Every single night.

speaker: bit
text: Because at 8 p.m. nobody wants to *think*.

speaker: bit
text: So decide once. On *Sunday*. With AI.

speaker: bit
text: Ask for five dinners. Give it a *budget*.

speaker: bit
text: Half a bag of spinach rots. Reuse it, and you waste *nothing*.

speaker: bit
text: Step two. One *shopping list*. Sorted by aisle.

speaker: bit
text: Not always. Prices change by store. So check the *total*.

speaker: bit
text: Step three. Ask: which dinner can I cook *twice* and freeze?

speaker: hero
text: Friday night. No takeout. I cooked *five times*!

speaker: bit
text: Proud of you. Saturday? Pizza. You *earned* it.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
